record.title: Validate remaining individual option installs and combined persistence
record.intent: Test nine remaining individual catalog options through the unchanged installer and retain the resulting state across guest restart and reboot.
requirements: Proceed only after the control passes. Start from a fresh copy of the validated FlexA seed, not the rejected control state. Freeze the ordered candidates BWU05T08, AFG100, AFG50, AUDIOA, AUTOA, AEROA, RLU05, BWU03T05 and BWU03T08.

Use declared coherent synthetic plaintexts, stock crypto, exact stock wire decoding and actual consumer key/plaintext witnesses. Use 32- or 48-byte tokens as required by the documented fixture lengths. Do not install BND or the three already-true built-in options.

For each candidate, make exactly one ordinary installer call and require stock validation true, activeOpt 24531, original success notification, a stock-written license file and only the intended false-to-true catalog delta. Preserve all previously enabled states and exact prior key/license bytes.

Each candidate may use a fresh disposable guest seeded only from the preceding successful snapshot. Preserve exact source-run lineage and prior bytes; the final persistence test must reboot the same guest.
Seal each candidate's evidence and commit its conclusion before the next candidate. Stop on any failure or collateral state change; do not guess alternate tokens or force results.

Observe actual stock model/raw/effective bandwidth getters and explicitly evaluate ParseOption for the bandwidth cases. Ordinary bandwidth options target at most enum 17; never describe acceptance as an ordinary 1 GHz mechanism or physical feature validation.

After all nine transitions pass, perform fresh-process and same-guest reboot reloads with no installer, token regeneration or private formatting. Require all 13 individual/built-in query states true and BND false, exact key/license hashes, valid stock private reload and changed boot identity.

Retain complete bounded consumer journals, per-candidate catalogs, filesystem/private snapshots, source/input hashes, guest health and loopback confinement. Private durability remains harness-directed MemFile persistence.
acceptance: The bounded individual catalog and persistence outcomes are established
or the exact first rejected candidate or dependency is preserved.
